# **ACRv3 Setup Guide**

## Note: You need a GitHub account before using this guide. If you do not have one, create one at [http\://github.com/signup](http://github.com/signup) 

## Step 1: Setting up Cloudflare and Github

| Go to: [https\://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up](https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up)  And sign up with GitHub, using your GitHub account. If you do not have one, create a GitHub account (see above) | ![][image1]![][image2]![][image3]  |
| :---- | :---- |
| After you log in, open this link:[https\://github.com/apps/cloudflare-workers-and-pages](https://github.com/apps/cloudflare-workers-and-pages)  Click Install | ![][image4] |
| Click Install and Authorize | ![][image5] |
| Next, open this link:[https\://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=%2F%3Aaccount%2Fworkers-and-pages%2Fcreate%2Fdeploy-to-workers\&repository=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhermanboxcar5%2Facrv3](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=%2F%3Aaccount%2Fworkers-and-pages%2Fcreate%2Fdeploy-to-workers&repository=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhermanboxcar5%2Facrv3)   | ![][image6] |
| Once you see this page, click Install and authorize | ![][image7] |

## Step 2: Get your Jellycade Token

### Method 1: Chrome Extension

| Go to[https\://cookie-editor.com/](https://cookie-editor.com/)  And install it for your browser | ![][image8] |
| :---- | :---- |
| Open RBR on Jellycade | ![][image9] |
| Click on the cookie editor extension.  Give it permission to read cookies. Either option works.  | ![][image10] |
| Look for a cookie named \_\_Host-portal.session\_token And open it.  | ![][image11] |
| You should see your jellycade token where  \[YOUR TOKEN\] Is written in this example.  Copy it or store it somewhere; we will use this value later | ![][image12] |

## Step 3: Deploying the instance

| Then, open this link again in a new tab[https\://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=%2F%3Aaccount%2Fworkers-and-pages%2Fcreate%2Fdeploy-to-workers\&repository=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhermanboxcar5%2Facrv3](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=%2F%3Aaccount%2Fworkers-and-pages%2Fcreate%2Fdeploy-to-workers&repository=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhermanboxcar5%2Facrv3)  You should now see a git account selector. Select your account. Then, click Deploy  | ![][image13]![][image14] |
| :---- | :---- |
| Wait \~30 seconds for the instance to deploy.  Then, on the top bar, go to Settings | ![][image15] |
| In settings, on the top right click Add Variable | ![][image16] |
| For the key, write JELLYCADE\_TOKEN Do not modify the spelling, capitalization, etc. For the value, enter your jellycade token that we got earlier.  Check "Secret"Then click Add 1 Variable and Deploy | ![][image17] |
| After you add the token into Cloudflare, click on the Domains button on the top bar.  Enable the first URL labeled Production | ![][image18]![][image19] |
| Copy the production URL and open it in a new tab.  Then, add /run to the end of the URL. Your final url should look like [https\://something.workers.dev/run](https://something.workers.dev/run) Check if the ACR works. If the response looks like either of the ones on the right, it works; you are done\! The ACR will automatically run every 31-32 minutes to get you coins.  Note: DO NOT reload this page a lot or visit it over and over again. Each time it tries to claim the bonus, and this might trigger Cloudflare anti-DDoS protection | ![][image20]![][image21] |
